[Intro]
[D5]

[Bridge]

[Verse 1]
The least suspec-
ted is never far
from the sin
And the lion's share
is not to be
shared If it's
there to take

[Verse 2]
Within this church
of dissipation
Awaiting to
be absolved
Feigning
all repulsion
Is it love
or is it com-

[Bridge]
pulsion?
Aim you
arrows and
sing

[Chorus]
Worship
Decay
[G5][Bb5]Parasites
[F5][G5]feasting
[D5]Are you
craving
[Bb5][G5]violence
[F5]and [Eb5]tyranny?
[D5]They will
vilify a-
[G5]nything [Bb5]
[F5]To [G5]keep
[D5]hell
for themselves
[F5]
[G5]
No walls in this

[Bridge]
[D5]prison

[Verse 3]
Give them an
inch
And they'll take the
fucking world
You get what you
give
But they take from the
herd

[Verse 4]
We stand in stag-
nation Staring
up from the gutter

waste Don't complain
Just be
thankful you get a
taste

is the

see
